source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 347 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-347.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 347 was established by Ordinance No. 20874, passed by the Dallas City Council on February 13, 1991. Ordinance No. 20874 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 20874; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-347.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 347 is established on property generally located at the northwest corner of Abrams Road and Merriman Parkway. The size of PD 347 is approximately 2.4537 acres. (Ord. Nos. 20874; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-347.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article refer to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 20874; 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-347.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 347A). (Ord. Nos. 20874; 25850)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-347.105. USES.

The only uses permitted on the Property are those allowed in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District. (Ord. Nos. 20874; 25850)

sections.title: Minimum Spacing
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-347.106. MINIMUM SPACING.

Minimum spacing between main structures on the Property is 10 feet. (Ord. Nos. 20874; 25850)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-347.107. SETBACKS.

(a) Except as provided in Subsection (b), minimum setbacks for the Property are governed by the platted building lines shown on the development plan.

(b) If no platted building line is shown on the development plan, setback requirements of the R-7.5 Single Family District apply on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 20874; 25850)

sections.title: Maximum Lot Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-347.108. MAXIMUM LOT COVERAGE.

Maximum lot coverage permitted on the Property is 45 percent. (Ord. Nos. 20874; 25850)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-347.109. HEIGHT.

No structure on the Property may exceed 30 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 20874; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-347.110. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Use of the Property must comply with all applicable federal and state laws and regulations and with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20874; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-347.111. ZONING MAP.

PD 347 is located on Zoning Map No. F-9. (Ord. Nos. 20874; 25850)
